title: I Want to Eat Your Pancreas
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: A withdrawn high schooler finds the secret journal of classmate Sakura Yamauchi, a cheerful girl with a terminal pancreatic illness. She pulls him into outings, including a trip to Fukuoka, to make the most of her remaining time. Before her illness can take her, she is killed by a random attacker, and he must grieve and reach out to her best friend Kyoko.
life_message: It holds up opening yourself to other people and living each day fully, because no one knows how much time they have.

delivery.note: The message about connection is carried by the contrast between the two leads, and the withdrawn narrator is treated with sympathy as he changes.

winners_losers: The narrator wins a capacity for friendship and Kyoko gains a new friend; Sakura loses her life to chance. Sympathy goes to openness and human connection.
